purpose: Run three newly installed local deployments through the complete current text Capability Suite and evaluate them jointly against the selected canonical evidence.

suite.request_derivation: 15 cases x one cold request x one immediate warm request x three deployments

execution_order.execution_caveat: Host standby interrupted elapsed execution and Ollama returned inconsistent duration telemetry in multiple later cases; performance evidence is diagnostic only.

conditions: known competing Ollama clients are stopped
Ollama reports no loaded model for the observation window
the requested tag resolves to the preregistered digest
no retry or adaptive repair is introduced after seeing an answer

resume_policy.unfinished_case: Preserve the partial attempt and start one fresh cold/warm pair under unchanged identities.

evaluation.quality_candidate: warm run from each completed case
evaluation.reason_for_variable_count: The first thirteen canonical comparisons contain four incumbents; the two writing comparisons already contain Ornith as a fifth incumbent.
evaluation.blinding: Fresh opaque candidate IDs are assigned independently for every case. Model mappings remain in the ignored private map until judgment is complete.

track_b_eligibility.granite4.2:30b: Ollama advertises completion but not native tools; native-tool harness use requires an explicit fallback design or compatibility qualification.
track_b_eligibility.nemotron-3.5-lightning:30b-mlx: Ollama advertises completion, thinking and tools; every Track B harness still requires an executable qualification.
track_b_eligibility.gemma4:31b-mlx: Ollama advertises completion, thinking and tools; every Track B harness still requires an executable qualification.
